_comment: Autonomous System Numbers (as integers, without the AS prefix) for known datacenter / hosting / cloud / VPN providers. Used by core/CloakDetector.php to flag suspicious visitors for cloaking. Editable: add or remove entries as your moderation landscape changes. Sources: public cloud provider ASN lists and well-known VPN/hosting ASNs. Consumer ISPs and mobile carriers (Kyivstar AS15895, Korea Telecom AS3559, Bredband2 AS45011 and friends) do not belong here — flagging them punishes ordinary visitors, so they were removed.
